Title: A Synthetic Test Book

*** START OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK A SYNTHETIC TEST BOOK ***




A Synthetic Test Book.


PREFACE.

This preface paragraph exists so the importer has text before the first
section heading. It is wrapped across several lines on purpose.


ALPHA EXAMPLE.

COMMON NAME, Alpha test plant.

PREPARATION.--The fresh test plant is described here in invented words
so that keyword search has something to find, such as the word
quillwort and the phrase burning sensation.

A second paragraph about alpha mentions the dry cough and restless
evenings reported by an imaginary writer in 1899.


BETA EXAMPLE.

COMMON NAME, Beta test mineral.

Beta paragraph one talks about a throbbing headache and nothing else of
note. The word café checks accented characters.

Beta paragraph two repeats burning sensation so phrase search returns
more than one section.
